evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'This should take about 65 to ten minutes of your time. Then we'll be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on. Sounds good.' — no actual wait for yes; customer responds 'Yeah, sounds good' but rep immediately pivots into probing without confirming readiness.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after probing started. Rep begins with 'What are your biggest concerns or are there any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' but this comes only after 'Let's start with a few questions.' The customer's response ('just to see like, how much it costs') is minimal and not explored deeper.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Tony Riley), moving day (not explicitly stated but implied), city-to-city route (Fort Worth to Sugarville, TX), and approximate size (1 bedroom, 775 sq ft destination) all confirmed.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor/stories (first floor both locations), rooms (1 bedroom, no additional rooms), walking distance (50 feet origin, 100 feet destination — customer corrects to closer), special considerations (glass-top coffee table and dining table, 50 boxes needed), access concerns checked. Seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asks 'Do you need help in packing like putting the small items like your codes, your kitchen wares into the boxes.' Customer declines.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep states 'The typical box count for your home size is fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' Customer responds 'I probably may need more boxes. So probably maybe like around fifty boxes.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides hourly rate ($103 per hour per mover) and trip fee ($960) but never anchors to a total estimate range for this customer's move (e.g., '$X to $Y based on 2–3 hours and your box count'). Pricing framing is comprehensive but no personalized dollar anchor delivered.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full transparency on trip fee, gas, truck, insurance, wraps, tools included. Minimum 2.5 hours, 15-minute increments after, time starts on-site, no hidden fees all stated clearly.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. After the detailed pricing explanation, customer says 'I just want to get like, the quote but no, no, it's okay, I don't want to continue.' Rep does not pause or address this objection — moves directly to asking if they want the quote sent.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered: 'We value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Fully delivered: 'We will provide up to 2000 dollars PerMe that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items.' No deductible or fine-print language mentioned, but coverage and amount are clear. Built into the rate as stated ('included on the already rate').
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No version of 'Does that put those to rest?' asked. After the Two Promises, customer expresses hesitation ('I just want to get like, the quote but no, no, it's okay, I don't want to continue') and rep does not loop back to confirm the promises address their concern or ask what's still unclear.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. After customer's objection, rep pivots to 'would you still want me to send you the code?' — an administrative question, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' is present.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep asks 'would you still want me to send you the code?' (administrative, not a business ask). Customer says no, and call ends without 'Would you like our help with your move?'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No language about locking in the rate or protecting against price changes.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. Call ends with customer declining the quote. No date, phone, arrival window, crew size, or addresses re-confirmed as a booking.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floors, room count, walking distances, special items, fragile items, box count) across both locations with natural follow-ups, painting a full picture of the move.
coaching_note: When the customer signals hesitation mid-call ('I don't want to continue'), the rep abandoned the sale rather than addressing the objection — ask 'What's holding you back?' or 'What would help you move forward?' before accepting a no.
